age.detail: Age reported separately by sex: male M=16.9, SD=6.5; female M=15.1, SD=5.8; range 8–39. Weighted mean=(430×16.9+52×15.1)/482=16.71; pooled SD=sqrt((429×6.5²+51×5.8²)/480)=6.43.
